valley-bridge.name: Valley Bridge
valley-bridge.description: An old stone bridge crossing the silver river. Lanterns flicker each evening.

market-square.name: Market Square
market-square.description: Bustling market with stalls selling spices, trinkets, and rumors.

guild-hall.name: Guild Hall
guild-hall.description: A grand wooden building where merchants and artisans gather. The floorboards creak with secrets.

elara.name: Elara Swift
elara.backstory: A former royal guard who left service after her brother disappeared. Quiet, observant, relentless.
elara.goal: Find my brother. He vanished near the river three weeks ago. Someone in this market knows something.

merchant-ronn.name: Ronn the Spice-Merchant
merchant-ronn.backstory: Loud, cheerful, always has a lead on city gossip. Secretly funds a small rescue crew.
merchant-ronn.goal: Keep an ear out for trouble. Help Elara if she asks but don't reveal the rescue crew unless necessary.
knowledge: A group called the Marsh Raiders has been kidnapping travelers
Kaelen Swift was last seen heading toward the Old Spice Cellar

find-brother.title: The Missing Brother
find-brother.description: Find clues about the disappearance of Kaelen Swift, who vanished while on patrol near the river.
